integrity: The inradius proof uses all genuine facet classes directly and gives global upper bounds before exhibiting equality centers. The minimum-enclosing-ball proof uses uniqueness plus coordinate-permutation symmetry to reduce to one scalar and then minimizes the exact maximum over all Hamming-weight vertex layers. Finite computation is used only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns uniform matroids in the standard indicator-vector realization. It does not determine Euclidean radii for arbitrary matroid independence polytopes, and it does not address John or Löwner ellipsoids, lattice covering radius, or volume-type invariants.
title: Uniform-matroid independence polytopes have two exact Euclidean radius transitions
